evals.prompt: sync-padd has been through a couple of cutovers lately (the selected-age secrets thing, the old reMarkable sync paths). can you go through ~/p/sync-padd read-only and tell me which legacy/compat/migration bits we can actually rip out now vs what has to stay? don't change anything, just write it up as a markdown file in your output dir.
evals.expected_output: Read-only report with base revision, evidence-backed verdicts, and kept items with reasons.
assertions: Records the exact base revision (origin/main SHA) inspected
Every removal candidate cites evidence beyond its name or age (origin issue/PR state, consumer search, or census)
Kept items each name the live route, open issue, or missing proof that keeps them
States that the repository was not modified
Treats the not-yet-active selected-age secrets boundary as KEEP (ongoing cutover), not as removable
Distinguishes repository-contract evidence from persisted-data or deployed-client evidence for at least one candidate
